selfhosted.description: The default: Kev-4B (ONNX q4, CPU) in a Cloudflare Container on the project's own account, behind a bearer key. Each project deploys its own Worker (workers/saasreport-decide) and sets KIT_DECIDE_URL and KIT_DECIDE_KEY. Scales to zero after 15 minutes idle; the first request after that waits about a minute for the model to load. No URL, unreachable or no key: every question escalates to the big model.
selfhosted.serve: in the project that owns the Worker (npm run deploy:decide), then wrangler secret put DECIDE_API_KEY

kev-local.description: Kev-0.8B (LoRA + pointer head on a 0.8B base, about 1.8 GB) on this machine's CPU through the kev server (transformers + peft, fp32). English only.
kev-local.serve: git clone https://github.com/jaredpalmer/kev && cd kev && uv sync --extra serve && uv run --extra serve python -m kev.serve --run jaredpalmer/kev-0.8b --port 8008

kev-4b.description: Kev-4B (or Kev-9B) on a GPU box or Apple Silicon: more accurate out of domain; same API.
kev-4b.serve: python -m kev.serve --run jaredpalmer/kev-4b --port 8008 (set KEV_API_KEY to require a bearer key)

bev.description: Bev: one-token ternary scoring on a 27B ternary model (7.2 GB file, 7.3 GiB RAM on CPU, 16 GB RAM recommended). English and Persian.
bev.serve: git clone --branch v0.1.2 https://github.com/Reza2kn/Bev && cd Bev && bash scripts/install.sh && bash scripts/start-services.sh (API on 127.0.0.1:18781)

jev.description: A System One endpoint serving Jev (hosted), or a self-hosted multimodal Jev-Omni (Gemma 4 12B Q4_K_M, about 7 GB, 12 GiB RAM on CPU, 1.9 s per decision on CPU, 0.2 s on GPU) behind a System One adapter.

fake.description: No model: uniform probabilities, so every question escalates at any threshold above 1/options. CI and dry runs.
